title: bammetrics.manifest/2
description: PREFIX.manifest.json of a chain that resumes, keeps a stream or ends in qc (docs/chaining.md section 22): the source's fingerprint, one record per step with what chain --resume compares, and the kept streams. Frozen: until 1.0.0 the schema changes only by adding members (docs/formats.md, Frozen schemas).

tool_version.description: The bammetrics version of the run; another version reruns every step.

directory.description: The working directory of the run, absolute with links followed: every relative path of the manifest is relative to it.

stringency.description: How a SAM text source was read.

kept.description: The streams kept as BAMs (--keep): the transform's id, the stream and the BAM.

file.description: A file a step reads by name, with its fingerprint: the size, the mtime (seconds.nanoseconds since the epoch) and the FNV-1a 64 of its first and last 64 KiB; null for a pipe.

output.description: A file a step wrote, with its kind and its fingerprint after the write.

kind.description: metrics, gaps, file, bam, sam, index, md5, kept, intervals, verdict, report, pdf, or a further format (json, markdown, junit, ...).

id.description: A transform's stream (marked), else VERB@STREAM (insert-size@marked), #2 for a second one; qc for the qc step.

upstream.description: The ids of the transforms in front of the step.

argv.description: The canonical argv: a tool's Picard arguments, write's and qc's options.

options_hash.description: FNV-1a 64 of the argv, the tool version, the formats, the sample and the stringency.

skipped.description: True when this run kept the record of the run before.
